text:
lina: Hey team — customer reporting intermittent 504s from our hosted API when using the Go SDK. They say it correlates with spikes and a client that sets per-request contexts + a shared http.Client with Timeout set. Repro steps below, can someone triage?

lina: Repro (simplified):
```
// main.go
cli := redwood.NewClient("$API_KEY", redwood.WithHTTPClient(&http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}))
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
defer cancel()
resp, err := cli.Generate(ctx, req)
// sometimes err == context.DeadlineExceeded, sometimes request returns 504 from gateway
```

lina: Observed: 1) client sometimes sees ctx deadline exceeded even though server logs show request still being processed. 2) other times request reaches backend but gateway returns 504 after ~25s.

lina: Go version: 1.20. SDK version: go.redwood.io v0.9.1. Transport is default net/http.Transport with MaxIdleConnsPerHost=100.

tom: Thanks, Lina. Quick Qs: do they reuse the same request context across retries or create a fresh one per attempt? Also any proxy in path?

lina: They create a fresh ctx per top-level request but rely on SDK's internal retry transport for transient 5xxs. No corporate proxy.

raj: Sounds like a mix of client-side timeouts + SDK retry logic + connection reuse. A couple of things to check: 1) http.Client.Timeout will cancel the whole request including redirects/retries — it wraps the whole call. 2) context.WithTimeout cancels the request immediately at deadline. If SDK retries happen after the ctx is expired, retries are aborted.

raj: Could also be Keep-Alive reuse with connection stuck in TIME_WAIT when server is slow, and gateway returns 504 because it hit a per-request deadline. Any transport-level logs? You can enable net/http debug by setting GODEBUG or instrumenting hooks.

lina: Customer sent logs from the SDK: they show a retry attempt starting at t=0, ctx canceled at t=10s, but server still processing and returns 200 at t=22s — that 200 arrives after ctx cancellation and is ignored. Meanwhile gateway layer times out and gives 504 around 25s.

tom: Two immediate mitigations: 1) Do NOT set http.Client.Timeout when you also use per-request contexts for cancellation — choose one approach. If you need global safety, set Transport-level timeouts (Dial/Idle) rather than the high-level Timeout which wraps everything. 2) Ensure SDK retries create a new child context per attempt that respects the original deadline. The SDK should be doing this, but older v0.9.1 had a bug where retries reused a canceled context. Try upgrading to v0.10.2 where retry context handling was fixed.

raj: Config snippet we recommend for long polling/generative calls:
```
tr := &http.Transport{
  DialContext: (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 10 * time.Second, KeepAlive: 30 * time.Second}).DialContext,
  MaxIdleConns: 100,
  MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 100,
  IdleConnTimeout: 90 * time.Second,
}
cliHTTP := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 0} // rely on per-request contexts
cli := redwood.NewClient(apiKey, redwood.WithHTTPClient(cliHTTP))
```

raj: If you must use http.Client.Timeout, make it larger than your per-request ctx deadline and watch for interaction with SDK retries.

lina: Got it. I'll try v0.10.2 + the transport config and ask customer to remove the top-level Timeout. Any quick debug flags to collect if problem persists?

tom: Ask them to enable SDK debug and collect: SDK request id header (X-Request-Id), upstream gateway request id, client-side logs with timestamps for attempt start/finish, and net/http trace. Example to collect trace: set r = req.WithContext(ctx) then use httptrace.WithClientTrace(ctx, trace) to log DNS/dial/tls/first-byte timings.

raj: Also capture the exact error strings returned by the SDK — is it context.DeadlineExceeded, or a wrapped error from the SDK retry layer (e.g., "request canceled while retrying"). That helps us see if retries were attempted after cancel.

lina: Will gather artifacts and follow up. For now recommended action: upgrade SDK, remove client Timeout, use transport-level Dial/Idle settings, and add net/http trace if they can reproduce. Thanks! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment v0.10.2 of go.redwood.io released to staging (changelog: fix retry context handling, improved retry jitter).

lina: Nice, I'll ask customer to test staging build and report back.

tom: If they can't upgrade, short-term patch: set SDK option to disable automatic retries and implement explicit retry logic with fresh contexts per attempt.
